title: Dancing Diffusion: Learning Continuous Programs for Image Generation and Editing
abstract: arXiv:2610.28003v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion models generate samples through a multi-step denoising trajectory, yet condition every step on the same instruction, so the trajectory cannot be addressed at the level of individual operations. We introduce Dancing Diffusion, which assigns each span of timesteps a dedicated continuous condition block and thereby turns conditioning into a latent program. A compiler maps text features into this program, and a fixed pretrained generator executes its blocks over successive sampling intervals. The trajectory can then dance, keeping its executed history while its continuation is redirected. A shared prefix is executed once and reused, and a later operation is rewritten while content fixed by earlier operations is preserved. The compiler is trained through the images it produces, with visual feedback on both the requested change and the retained content. translated_title: Dancing Diffusion：面向图像生成与编辑的连续程序学习
translated_abstract: 扩散模型通过多步去噪轨迹生成样本，但每一步都以相同的指令为条件，因此无法在单个操作的层面上对轨迹进行操控。我们提出 Dancing Diffusion，它为每段时间步分配一个专用的连续条件块，从而将条件控制转化为一个潜在程序。一个编译器将文本特征映射到该程序中，而固定的预训练生成器在连续的采样区间上依次执行程序的各个块。这样轨迹便可以“起舞”——在保持已执行历史的同时，将其后续延续重定向。共享的前缀只需执行一次并被复用，后续操作可被改写，同时保留由先前操作固定的内容。编译器通过其生成的图像进行训练，对请求的更改和保留的内容均获得视觉反馈。在 SANA 上，复用已执行的前缀比重新生成能显著保留更多场景内容。
tldr: 该论文提出 Dancing Diffusion，通过为每段时间步分配专用的连续条件块，将扩散模型的条件控制转化为可由编译器从文本特征编译出的潜在程序，实现了去噪轨迹中已执行前缀的复用与后续操作的改写，从而在精确保留已生成内容的同时进行图像生成与编辑。
en_tdlr: Dancing Diffusion turns diffusion conditioning into a latent program compiled from text features, assigning dedicated continuous condition blocks to timestep spans so that the executed prefix can be reused and later operations rewritten, enabling image editing while preserving already-generated content.
